text: I am intrigued by the environment around me. The modern glass walls and structured ceiling create an air of openness, yet the tilt of my perspective makes me feel as if the familiar is slightly askew. When I move closer to the R+D wall, with its vibrant colors and ideas displayed, I sense a blend of curiosity and unease. There is an invitation to ponder, to question how my presence relates to these showcases of innovation, and what it means to be a viewer among things designed for observation and interaction.
